title: 메타팩토리 · 환경 · 설비 센서
description: 환경(온습도·진동·PM2.5 등)·설비 센서 — 셀 엣지 묶음 metafactory/sensors/v1 · 유연생산 C01 키팅 (metafactory/kit/v1)

list.name: metric
list.label: 지표
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "raw", tag: "m", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all"), start: -1d)

target.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "alert" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "warn" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "event" and r.level == "act" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, text: r.title + (if exists r.text then " — " + r.text else ""), tags: r.zone }))

targets.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "v" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all") and r.m =~ /^${metric:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.m + " · " + r.s + " (" + r.u + ")" })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "v" and (r.zone == "${zone}" or "${zone}" == "all") and r.m =~ /^${metric:regex}$/) |> last() |> group() |> keep(columns: ["zone", "cell", "s", "m", "u", "_value", "_time"]) |> sort(columns: ["zone", "cell", "m"])

panels.title: C01 보울 피더 진동 (mm/s · 막힘 전조)

targets.query: from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kit" and r._field == "feedVib") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.asset })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kit" and r._field == "stock") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.asset })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])

from(bucket: "raw") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kit_part" and r._field == "weight_g") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.asset })) |> group(columns: ["_field"])
